study_design: Prospective population-based cohort study using Cox proportional hazards regression
cohort_total_n_excerpt: Adherence to a modified Mediterranean Diet Score (mMDS) and a low carbohydrate-high protein (LCHP) score were grouped as low, medium, or high in the whole study population (n = 1,044) and in those identified as adequate reporters of energy intake (n = 566), respectively.
reason: The cohort analysis reports prostate cancer incidence in the full population and an adequate-reporters subgroup. No aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, or lethal incident endpoint is analyzed.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Among adequate reporters the mMDS was not associated with prostate cancer (n = 72).
estimate_classifications.reason: This row concerns overall prostate cancer among the 566 adequate reporters, with 72 cases. It does not concern aggressive disease.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: There were no associations between dietary patterns and prostate cancer (n = 133) in the whole study population.
